test_cases.title: Verify WashTAB home page loads successfully
test_cases.objective: Ensure the WashTAB home dashboard loads and key UI elements are visible.
preconditions: User has access to the WashTAB application
steps: Open the WashTAB home URL in the browser
Observe the header and dashboard area
Verify presence of the home icon, notifications button, and user chip displaying 'haklarr'
Verify multiple dashboard tile buttons are displayed
expected_results: WashTAB home page loads without errors
Home icon is visible in the header
Dashboard tile buttons are displayed on the page

test_cases.title: Verify user logout from header
test_cases.objective: Ensure a logged-in user can initiate logout using the logout icon.
preconditions: User chip 'haklarr' and log-out icon are visible
steps: Click the log-out icon inside the user chip
expected_results: User session ends and user is logged out of the application

test_cases.title: Verify notifications button is disabled
test_cases.objective: Confirm that the notifications button cannot be interacted with when disabled.
preconditions: User is on the WashTAB home page
steps: Locate the notifications button with id 'notifications-button'
Attempt to click the notifications button
expected_results: Clicking the disabled notifications button does not trigger any action

test_cases.title: Verify navigation using back arrow icon
test_cases.objective: Ensure the arrow-back icon performs a navigation action when selected.
preconditions: User is on the WashTAB home page
Arrow-back icon is visible in the header
expected_results: Application performs a navigation action to the previous or parent screen

test_cases.title: Verify dashboard tile buttons respond to user interaction
test_cases.objective: Ensure dashboard tiles are interactive and respond to user clicks.
steps: Locate any dashboard tile with class 'innerBtn'
expected_results: Tile responds to the click interaction
Application triggers the corresponding module action or navigation

test_cases.title: Verify 'Coming Soon!' tile is not active
test_cases.objective: Ensure the 'Coming Soon!' tile indicates unavailable functionality and does not perform actions.
preconditions: User is on the WashTAB home page
steps: Locate the tile displaying text 'Coming Soon!'
expected_results: Tile does not navigate or trigger any functional workflow
